title: Fraud Is The Inevitable Result Of Democrats’ Marxist Politics
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Fraud Is The Inevitable Result Of Democrats’ Marxist Politics

Although voters have every reason to grumble about affordability, they should not be fooled into thinking that putting Democrats into office will fix anything.

Actual Article Body:
Although voters have every reason to grumble about affordability, they should not be fooled into thinking that putting Democrats into office will fix anything.

Another day, another instance of mass fraud. Just in the last week, a bogus Minnesota nonprofit, Partners in Nutrition (PiN), agreed to pay $18.5 million for stealing from a child food distribution program. In Ohio, “Eighteen Medicaid providers across the state … have been accused of stealing more than $355,000 from the government healthcare program for the needy.” Additionally, Vice President J.D. Vance recently “announced … that 750,000 people allegedly fraudulently enrolled in Affordable Care Act insurance plans will be kicked off the programs,” a move that will “save American taxpayers $2.2 billion.”

More and more, today’s welfare programs are becoming better known for enabling egregious fraud than for helping people in need, and this is understandably becoming an important issue for voters. Politically speaking, this is good news for reform-minded Republicans and bad news for spendthrift Democrats who want even more entitlement spending.

Surprisingly, the person publicly pointing this out is none other than New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Speaking at the Urban 20 Mayors Summit, the socialist theater-kid extraordinaire declared, “Quality of life has come to be seen as somehow a right-wing concern. Efficiency … has been taken on as a right-wing concern, rooting out fraud and waste, a right-wing concern.” Meanwhile, Democrat politicians like Mamdani are not taken seriously on such issues.

This might be due to the many brazen examples of fraud in blue states that have surfaced over the past year. Besides Minnesota and Ohio, Chris Rufo continues to uncover widespread fraud in California and even criminal conspiracies among leftist NGOs. And in Mamdani’s own city of New York, the biggest source of work for New Yorkers is home health care, a dubious form of employment that is tailor-made for fraudsters.

It also doesn’t help that unassimilated immigrants make up a large number of people committing the fraud. As conservative podcaster Matt Walsh discussed in a recent episode, so many millions of dollars in Covid grants and loans went to foreign fraudsters who used the money to buy mansions and luxury cars and, in one case, to assassinate the president of Haiti. Apparently, some even wrote rap songs bragging about their ill-gotten fortunes.

Naturally, leftists such as Mamdani see this as a mere messaging problem. It can’t be that Democrat policies facilitate mass fraud; they simply aren’t applying the proper communication techniques for these issues: “If you are staring at an example of social disorder or social inefficiency, and the left refuses to explain either why it has happened or how they will fix it, then the right gets to point at someone in the immediate area and say, ‘That’s who did it.’”

Presumably, the way Democrats take back this issue is to whine that conservatives are unfairly “pouncing” on them and make vain proposals that usually involve throwing more money at these issues.

It’s also notable that Mamdani uses euphemisms like “social inefficiency” to denote major problems like homelessness, fraud, crime, and blight. This subtly suggests that such crises are simply the result of some fixable error in an otherwise functional system. Surely, they can’t be the result of a faulty governing philosophy and an incompetent government.

But this is exactly why Democrats have a fraud problem. It has nothing to do with using the right language or enacting the right policy, and everything to do with Democrats’ core beliefs. This explains not only why most American cities continually suffer from dysfunction but also why fraud will proliferate and expand if Democrats win the majority in Congress this November.
